coverage.scope: A curated public reading set that orients investors, collaborators and technical reviewers across Aureon's research programme.
coverage.selection_policy: The formal records below are selected for strategic relevance, source clarity and their value in understanding the company's research-to-validation method. ORCID and Zenodo remain the public routes for the wider record.
coverage.record_status_policy: Each listed item is identified by its public source link and stated record type. A source link does not itself establish peer review, engineering validation, commercial readiness, or performance.
coverage.public_research_notes: Gary Leckey's public Substack research-notes channel is linked as contextual commentary. It is kept separate from the formal record index and is not presented as peer review, validation, or company performance evidence.
coverage.repository_working_material_note: The repository has a larger working-material library that is not presented as an independently validated publication list.
